items.title: Melco Resorts And Entertainment (MLCO) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Cautious Analyst Cuts
items.summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment has seen its fair value estimate moved from US$6.72 to US$6.18, an adjustment of about 8% in the latest analyst model. That shift lines up with more cautious Street commentary in recent months, where several firms have reduced ratings and price targets even as others still see room for the company to execute in Macau. items.title: CBRE (CBRE) Stock Still Looks Reasonable Following Its 82% Run
items.summary: CBRE Group has rallied over the past few years even as commercial property deal activity has been under pressure, which puts fresh focus on whether the current share price lines up with the cash the business can generate. With the stock closing at US$136.75 and the real estate cycle still adjusting to higher rates, the question is how firmly its cash flows support that tag.
